title: 木造在来 1/50 断面詳細図 作図ルール (社内練習データ 住宅A から抽出)

derivedFrom.environment: 住宅A 1/50 断面詳細 JWF
derivedFrom.method: codec decode + per-layer raster montage + offsets measured relative to grid Y1 and design GL (2026-10-02)
derivedFrom.privacy: Rules only. No client names, addresses, staff, company or logo data are stored here.

sheet.layout: one section centred; build-up boxes top-left (屋根, 室内 壁・天井) and top-right (外壁); floor/foundation list bottom-right with a leader; title box under the bottom tiers

textStyles.use: callouts 3.2 (style 3), dims + level labels 3.0 (style 7), small labels 2.8, title 4.0, grid labels 4.0 free size

layers.1:1: 構造体: foundation, slab layers, floor, wall assembly lines, roof layers, fascia/soffit, roof framing (pen 2 faces, pen 1 thin, pen 4 battens)
layers.1:2: 切断部材: 土台 / 大引 105, 桁 105x180 (low) / 105x105 (high), 母屋 105 with diagonals (pen 2 + pen 1)
layers.1:3: 床仕上げ線 (practice); generator draws the floor on 1:1
layers.1:4: 見え掛り建具・サッシ (window section in the cut wall)
layers.1:7: 見え掛り: 鋼製束 beyond, furniture (pen 4)
layers.1:8: ハッチ: gravel slashes, ceiling insulation top
layers.1:A: 断熱: wall GW wave (pen 8, ±35, 17.5 pitch), ceiling BGW 400 ±45° cross hatch 70.7, EPS slashes
layers.1:B: 色塗: EPS pink COLORREF e5e5ff (= RGB 255,229,229), concrete efefef, GL ▼
layers.1:C: 付加断熱 ±45° hatch in the -152..-62 band (pen 3)
layers.1:D: 文字: callout boxes, level labels, room boxes, grid bubbles R250 + 4 mm labels, title
layers.1:E: 寸法: vertical chains both sides, top tiers (eaves + grid / overall), bottom tiers, footing widths

measured.method: Practice house A section at 1/50, model mm relative to grid Y1 (u) and design GL (h)

wallAssembly.note: identical to the plan assembly; wall lines stop at the window head/sill

roof.fascia: perpendicular board at the low eave, vertical at the high eave

measured.topTiers: 600 | 3,640 | 2,730 | 1,820 | 270 and 8,190; bubbles for every grid line; bottom 3,640 / 2,730 / 1,820 and 8,190, footing 400 under each wall
